## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting player/contributor experience.

Task/issue or brief:
Roadmap milestone:
Human sponsor, implementer and independent reviewer:
Base/dependencies and claimed areas:
Target: normally `dev/all-features`; explain any stacked or release PR.

## Scope and contracts

Changes, explicit exclusions, compatibility/migrations and known limitations.
Name affected world/precision/collision/input/server/asset contracts. A studio or
local-only checkpoint must remain labeled. Keep secrets out of logs and evidence.

## Validation actually performed

- Commands, tested commit/assets and pass/fail/skip results:
- Browser/backend, seed, resolution/render scale and input method when relevant:
- Actual keyboard/controller/touch journey; physical versus injected device:
- Failure cases, inherited issues and unperformed checks with reasons:

Use proportionate checks. Documentation-only work does not need a fictional GPU tour.
A build does not prove shaders, physical geometry, durability or visual acceptance.

## Visual, asset and performance evidence

Before/after and motion captures, export/provenance, applicable QUALITY rubric and
measured budgets; or explain N/A. UI evidence includes desktop and phone sizes.
Independent acceptance: pending / changes requested / accepted (link exact review).
Do not reuse an old review for a changed asset or claim self-review is independent.

## Handoff and integration

- [ ] Relevant docs/status and HANDOFF updated; exact ownership and next steps clear.
- [ ] Other owners' changes preserved; integration dependencies explained.
- [ ] Known limits and unperformed checks remain visible.

Local integration is distinct from release approval. A promotion to `main` needs a
release record with the candidate, target, verification and existing authorization.
